sections.heading: What is Entrepreneurship?
sections.text: Entrepreneurship is starting and managing a business to create value and earn profit.

sections.heading: Why Important
sections.text: Creates jobs, drives innovation, and builds financial independence.

sections.heading: Business Ideas
sections.text: Ideas can come from skills, hobbies, or solving problems.

sections.heading: Business Plan
sections.text: Includes idea, target market, revenue model, costs, and marketing strategy.

sections.heading: Financial Responsibilities
sections.text: Manage income, expenses, taxes, and pricing.

sections.heading: Steps to Start
sections.text: Idea → Research → Plan → Fund → Launch → Improve
